paper.title_en: Geometrically Induced Semiclassical Limit for Quasinormal Modes and Greybody Factors in Higher-Dimensional Near-Ultracold spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the correspondence between quasinormal modes (QNMs) and greybody factors (GBFs) in higher-dimensional Reissner--Nordstöm--de Sitter black holes based on the massless scalar field. Our analysis focuses on the QNMs in the near-ultracold family where the inner, outer, and cosmological horizons are close together. Under the geometric limit condition, the leading-order Wentzel--Kramers--Brillouin term of the QNM is dominant for fixed angular quantum numbers and dimensionality without imposing the eikonal limit. Particularly, the corresponding GBFs also retain the explicit form of both parameters. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the half-transmission frequency of the GBF and its derivative are related to null geodesics, in terms of aspects such as the angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent, with the use of both parameters. We provide their relationships in arbitrary dimensionality. Furthermore, the higher-order corrections to the QNMs are investigated at the Nariai limit and in the near-ultracold geometry with separated horizons.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究高维 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 黑洞中准正规模与灰体因子的对应关系，聚焦近超冷视界家族，并在几何极限下不引入 eikonal 极限给出 WKB 领头阶结果，同时将半透射频率及其导数与零测地线的角频率和 Lyapunov 指数相联系，并讨论高阶修正；理论深度较高、主题与索引方向吻合，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 高维近超冷时空中准正规模与灰体因子的几何诱导半经典极限
decision.abstract_zh: 本文基于无质量标量场，研究高维 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 黑洞中准正规模（QNMs）与灰体因子（GBFs）之间的对应关系。我们的分析聚焦于内视界、外视界与宇宙学视界彼此接近的近超冷家族中的 QNMs。在几何极限条件下，对于固定的角量子数和维度，准正规模的领头阶 Wentzel–Kramers–Brillouin 项占主导，而无需施加 eikonal 极限。特别地，相应的灰体因子也保留了两个参数的显式形式。此外，我们证明灰体因子的半透射频率及其导数与零测地线相关，涉及角频率和 Lyapunov 指数等方面，并同时使用这两个参数。我们给出了它们在任意维度下的关系。此外，我们在 Nariai 极限下以及视界分离的近超冷几何中研究了准正规模的高阶修正。
